I found no security regression, new attack surface, or invalidated threat assumption in this text. Coverage limit: since no head-side changes were supplied, a later pass that sees the real diff should check that any changelog claims (for example, the 30-minute TTL in T-041 versus the older 15-minute figures) match the code.
